generated_by: docs/22, after partial_manipulation filed as a finding
status: pre-commit — written after the richness gate, before the Hamming-only one-arm and the 96
question: On the existing Hamming 2×3 at γ=10, do the cliff, the drift gradation, and the frozen–drift crossover reproduce under Adam at lr0=0.0002?
why_now: The richness gate read partial_manipulation (3.19× against 10×; steps 20.9×). That is a finding: μP and Adam do not compose. The 192 is refused. The Hamming-axis claims were found at both γ, so one γ is enough to ask whether they reproduce under a different optimiser.
why_gamma_10: Every Hamming-axis effect is largest at γ=10, so a failure to reproduce is unambiguous. Adam's lr at the pin is 0.094 rather than 0.00094 with 502 steps at γ=1.
cannot_speak_to_why: Those need a working richness manipulation. Adam supplies only a partial one. This arm tests whether the Hamming-axis findings are artefacts of full-batch GD. It is not a γ contrast.

design.manipulation: Same Hamming 2×3 as the GD-MSE slice, γ=10 only. Four exact Hamming levels at P=16, crossed with three input levels. Optimizer is Adam; loss, targets, streams, architecture, target_loss=0.05, and lr0=0.0002 are held.

optimizer.name: adam
optimizer.not: a search; library defaults. No momentum SGD. No RMSProp.

design.stopping: matched_loss at target_loss 0.05. Sequential K=1. The registered pin. Not re-pinned for this arm.

frozen.what: rule-only at s_r<1; no-change null at s_r=1

drift.what: slow consecutive centre motion; recovers finding 3 vs jump at s_r=1

first_slice.gamma_1_excluded: Adam does not supply a working richness manipulation. This arm cannot speak to γ.

held_fixed.lr0_provenance: The signed one-time Phase 0 re-pin in results/adam_precommit.json and results/adam_lr0_repin.md. Not re-pinned for this arm. Not informed by the Hamming axis or by this cell.

primary_cell.quantity: Δ log α (floors) against Hamming, per input level, γ=10 only
primary_cell.reported_not_a_reading: Lag-4 series across task position {0,2,4,6,8,10}. Δρ_c against Hamming, including frozen. Neither is a reading.

recovery.cell: At s_r=1, drift vs jump on reserved stream_ids, γ=10, unique n=8, module A, task 0 lag 12.
recovery.must: Keep the sign of finding 3 (gain under drift, loss under jump) or stop. The new streams are not the same object.
recovery.if_fails: finding3_fails_to_recover. Stop. Not one of the three Hamming readings.

misses.rule: An arm that misses target_loss on any task is unusable and counted.
misses.if_one_arm_misses: lr0_miss. Stop. Do not run the 96. Do not re-pin a second time.

one_arm_first.spec: γ=10, s_r=0.5, drift (not frozen), first reserved arrangement, a=0, N=300, quadratic, matched_loss, target_loss=0.05, lr0=0.0002, tracked_stride=2, Adam, MSE
one_arm_first.why: A Hamming cell that is not the richness-gate cell frozen × s_r=0.5. Drift is where the gradation lives. AGENTS.md §5.
one_arm_first.not: the frozen × s_r=0.5 one-arm already on file

readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.hamming_reproduces: Cliff, drift gradation, and frozen–drift crossover all hold. The Hamming-axis findings are not artefacts of full-batch GD.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.hamming_fails: None of the three hold. Name all three. The findings are scoped to the optimiser.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.partial: A split: report which held and which did not. No post-hoc story.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.finding3_fails_to_recover: At s_r=1, drift vs jump does not keep gain vs loss on Δ log α. Stop. The Adam streams are not the same object. Not a Hamming-axis reading.

operationalization.primary: Unique n=8, module A, task 0, lag 12, Δ log α vs Hamming, per input level, γ=10 only. 95% CI = mean ± 1.96 SEM.
operationalization.cliff_holds: At frozen and at jump: floors(s_r=1.0) − floors(s_r=0.75) ≥ 2 (1-decimal) AND the post-cliff range |floors(0.75) − floors(0.25)| does not clear two floors (range < 2, or 0.75 vs 0.25 CIs overlap).
operationalization.drift_gradation_holds: Under drift: 0.75 vs 0.25 CIs do not overlap AND that range is ≥ 2 floors.
operationalization.crossover_holds: At s_r=0.75, drift 1-decimal floors > frozen (drift better). At s_r=0.25, frozen 1-decimal floors > drift (frozen better).
operationalization.finding3_fails_to_recover: At s_r=1, drift mean Δ log α is not > 0 or jump is not < 0 (γ=10, unique n=8).
operationalization.hamming_reproduces: Recovery holds, and cliff, drift gradation, and crossover all hold.
operationalization.hamming_fails: Recovery holds, and none of cliff / drift gradation / crossover hold. Name all three.
operationalization.partial: Recovery holds, and a nonempty proper subset of the three hold. Report the split. No post-hoc story.
operationalization.gamma_1: Not in this arm. Do not interpret. Do not pool with GD γ=1.

will_not_do: Interpret γ, finding 1, or the channel reorganisation from this arm.
Inform lr0 or stopping from this axis.
Treat consecutive s_r as lag-12 s_r.
Salvage a stream claim from a partial split after seeing numbers.
Treat a reproduction as a second learner agreeing.
